title.purpose: Top-level view identity in light tracked capitals.

interface.purpose: Controls, rows, and compact operating text.

identifier.purpose: Models, paths, timestamps, and machine values.

shadows.name: transient
shadows.purpose: Dialogs and popovers only; light flavors use 0.14 alpha.

shadows.name: hud
shadows.purpose: Detached HUD only; light flavors use 0.22 alpha.

components.name: Selected Navigation Row
components.description: A raised whole-row selection without stripe or ring.

components.name: Agent Message
components.description: An attributed agent utterance carrying the agent identity hue.

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A compact editable row with a functional edge only while focused.

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: A non-clickable semantic state that always includes a word.

narrative.overview: IntelliZen is a precise macOS operating surface for intelligence work. Stable planes, deliberate whitespace, and attributed data make sophisticated work feel calm. The interface is advanced through behavior and clarity, never through glow, glass, ornamental gradients, or generic dashboard furniture.
keyCharacteristics: Three stable planes: rail, panel, and work.
Editorial hierarchy from space and type rather than decoration.
Dense desktop controls with complete keyboard parity.
Agent identity carried consistently by avatar, bubble, voice, and HUD.
Explicit loading, content, empty, error, and recovery states.

rules.name: Three-Plane Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from the relationship among rail, panel, and work, not borders around each pane.

rules.name: Selection in Lightness
rules.body: Selection shifts the raised plane by one signed OKLCH lightness step with a 0.06 floor.

rules.name: Borders Mean Two Things
rules.body: A border marks active editing or an explicitly named failure; swatches and live tree drop targets are the operational exceptions.

rules.name: Selection Strength
rules.body: Settings Appearance is the only writer of --sel-step, and every selected surface reads it.

rules.name: No Ghost Card Rule
rules.body: Do not combine a structural border, rounded container, and wide shadow on the same persistent surface.

dos: Keep loading, content, empty, error, disabled, and recovery visually distinct.
Pair color with text, position, shape, or iconography.
Use one selection-strength token for rows, cards, and segments.
Verify every primary surface at desktop, 390px, and 200% zoom.
donts: Use generic card grids as page scaffolding or nest cards inside cards.
Use arbitrary radii, font sizes, shadows, or palette utilities.
Use accent borders to decorate buttons, checkboxes, cards, or selection.
Pulse, spin, or shimmer to communicate waiting.
